name: Rainbow Community Center
description: Counseling, HIV/STI support, youth and senior programs, and community resources
fullDescription: Rainbow Community Center serves LGBTQ+ individuals and families in Contra Costa County with mental health therapy, HIV and STI support, youth and senior programs, and community events.
whatTheyOffer:
- Mental health therapy for individuals, couples, families, and youth
- HIV and STI support services
- Program for houseless transitional-age youth
- Senior programs
- Community resources and advocacy
- Equity and inclusion trainings
- Community events
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Rainbow Community Center during drop-in hours (Mon-Fri, 11 AM-4 PM)
2. Call 925-692-0090 to ask about counseling and HIV/STI services
3. Join support groups and programs
4. Check website for event schedule
keywords: Rainbow Community Center, Concord, Contra Costa, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, HIV, STI, mental health, therapy, counseling, youth programs, houseless youth, seniors
